$description: Meta Frames design system v2. Three layers: primitive -> semantic -> component. DTCG format for Style Dictionary.

primitive.$description: Layer 1. Raw values. Components never reference this layer directly.

semantic.$description: Layer 2. Intent and theme roles. Colour leaves hold the light value in $value and the dark value in $extensions["com.metaframes.modes"].dark. Build each mode by swapping that value into $value before reference resolution.

canvas.$description: Page background behind all other surfaces. Use bg.surface for cards and panels on top of it.

surface.$description: Background of cards and panels on the page canvas. Use bg.surface-raised for dialogs, menus and popovers.

surface-raised.$description: Background of layers that float above a surface, such as dialogs, menus and popovers. Use bg.surface for flat cards and panels.

subtle.$description: Quiet fill for hover rows, table headers and grouped areas. Do not use it as a page or card background.

inverse.$description: Dark fill in light mode and light fill in dark mode, for tooltips and toasts. Put fg.inverse text on it.

scrim.$description: Overlay behind a modal dialog or sheet. It is the same in light and dark mode.

default.$description: Main text and icon colour. Use fg.muted for secondary text.

muted.$description: Secondary text such as descriptions and helper text. It passes text contrast on bg.canvas and bg.surface. Use fg.subtle only for non-essential text.

subtle.$description: Weakest text colour, for hints and non-essential detail. Its contrast is not tested. Use fg.muted for text a user must read.

inverse.$description: Text and icons on bg.inverse. Do not use it on action.primary: use fg.on-primary.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on action.primary and action.primary-hover. Do not use it on other fills.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on action.accent and action.accent-hover.

on-danger.$description: Text and icons on action.danger and action.danger-hover.

default.$description: Divider and card outline. It is decorative. Use border.control for the edge of an input or button.

control.$description: Edge of form controls such as inputs, selects and checkboxes. It passes the 3:1 contrast needed for controls. Use border.default for dividers.

focus.$description: Focus ring colour on any interactive element. Pair it with border-width.focus. It passes 3:1 contrast on the page backgrounds.

primary.$description: Fill of the main button. Put fg.on-primary text on it. Use action.accent for the brand call to action.

primary-hover.$description: Fill of the main button on hover or press. Put fg.on-primary text on it.

accent.$description: Fill of the brand call-to-action button. Put fg.on-accent text on it. Use action.primary for normal main buttons.

accent-hover.$description: Fill of the accent button on hover or press. Put fg.on-accent text on it.

secondary.$description: Fill of the secondary button. Use fg.default text on it.

secondary-hover.$description: Fill of the secondary button on hover or press.

danger.$description: Fill of a destructive button, such as delete. Put fg.on-danger text on it. Use status.danger for messages.

danger-hover.$description: Fill of the destructive button on hover or press. Put fg.on-danger text on it.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for a success message or badge. Use it on status.success.bg.

bg.$description: Background of a success message or badge. Put status.success.fg on it.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for a warning message or badge. Use it on status.warning.bg.

bg.$description: Background of a warning message or badge. Put status.warning.fg on it.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for an error message or badge. Use it on status.danger.bg. Use action.danger for buttons.

bg.$description: Background of an error message or badge. Put status.danger.fg on it.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for an information message or badge. Use it on status.info.bg.

bg.$description: Background of an information message or badge. Put status.info.fg on it.

fg.$description: Text and icon colour for a neutral status badge with no good or bad meaning. Use it on status.neutral.bg.

bg.$description: Background of a neutral status badge. Put status.neutral.fg on it.

1.$description: First series colour in a chart. Use the chart colours in order 1 to 5.

2.$description: Second series colour in a chart.

3.$description: Third series colour in a chart.

4.$description: Fourth series colour in a chart.

5.$description: Fifth series colour in a chart.

bg.$description: Background of the C-41 label: the color film type and the C-41 process label. Put process.c41.fg on it. The app uses only the fg.

fg.$description: Text of the C-41 label on process.c41.bg. The app uses this color for the C-41 stamp, which draws its own tinted fill and border.

bg.$description: Background of the E-6 label: the slide film type and the E-6 process label. Put process.e6.fg on it. The app uses only the fg.

fg.$description: Text of the E-6 label on process.e6.bg. The app uses this color for the E-6 stamp, which draws its own tinted fill and border.

bg.$description: Background of the ECN-2 process label and the respooled packaging label. Put process.ecn2.fg on it. The app uses only the fg.

fg.$description: Text of the ECN-2 label on process.ecn2.bg. The app uses this color for the ECN-2 stamp, which draws its own tinted fill and border.

bg.$description: Background of the black and white label: the BW film type and the BW process label. Put process.bw.fg on it. The app uses only the fg.

fg.$description: Text of the black and white label on process.bw.bg. The app uses this color for the B&W stamp, which draws its own tinted fill and border.

bg.$description: Background of a metadata chip, such as a lens specification. Put highlight.fg on it.

fg.$description: Text of a metadata chip on highlight.bg.

border.$description: Outline of a metadata chip. Use it with highlight.bg.

bg.$description: Background of the activate button on equipment detail pages, such as cameras and lenses. Put activate.fg on it. Active and Inactive badges use status colors.

fg.$description: Text and icons of the activate button, on activate.bg.

border.$description: Outline of the activate button. Use it with activate.bg.

bg-hover.$description: Background of the activate button on hover or press.

fg-hover.$description: Text and icons of the activate button on hover, on activate.bg-hover.

bg.$description: Background of the deactivate button on equipment detail pages, such as cameras and lenses. Put deactivate.fg on it. Active and Inactive badges use status colors.

fg.$description: Text and icons of the deactivate button, on deactivate.bg.

border.$description: Outline of the deactivate button. Use it with deactivate.bg.

bg-hover.$description: Background of the deactivate button on hover or press.

fg-hover.$description: Text and icons of the deactivate button on hover, on deactivate.bg-hover.

stripe.$description: Colour of the decorative brand stripe on the auth card. It is the same in light and dark mode. Do not use it for text or controls.

xs.$description: Padding inside a component, smallest step. Use space.gap for the space between components.

sm.$description: Padding inside a compact component, such as a badge or a small button.

md.$description: Default padding inside a component, such as an input or a list row.

lg.$description: Padding inside a card or a panel.

xl.$description: Padding inside a large section or a dialog.

xs.$description: Smallest space between related elements, such as an icon and its label. Use space.inset for padding inside a component.

sm.$description: Space between closely related elements, such as form label and field.

md.$description: Default space between sibling elements in a group.

lg.$description: Space between groups of elements, such as form fields.

2xl.$description: Largest space between major page areas.

compact.$description: Page side margin on narrow screens, such as phones.

wide.$description: Page side margin on wide screens, such as desktop.

touch-min.$description: Smallest touch target height and width. Make every tap target at least this size.

sm.$description: Height of a small control, such as a compact button or input. It is smaller than size.touch-min, so add hit area around it.

md.$description: Height of the default control, such as a button or input.

lg.$description: Height of a large control, such as a main call-to-action button.

sm.$description: Small icon size, for icons inside dense rows or badges.

md.$description: Default icon size, for icons next to body text and in buttons.

lg.$description: Large icon size, for icons in headers and empty states.

control.$description: Corner radius of controls such as buttons and inputs. Use radius.surface for cards.

surface.$description: Corner radius of cards, panels and dialogs. Use radius.control for buttons and inputs.

pill.$description: Fully rounded corner, for badges, chips and avatars.

default.$description: Width of normal borders and dividers.

focus.$description: Width of the focus ring. Use it with color.border.focus.

font-family.$description: Font family of the display style.

font-size.$description: Largest text style, for the main title of a page or a hero area.

line-height.$description: Line height of the display style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the display style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the heading-1 style.

font-size.$description: Style of the main heading on a page.

line-height.$description: Line height of the heading-1 style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the heading-1 style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the heading-2 style.

line-height.$description: Line height of the heading-2 style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the heading-2 style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the heading-3 style.

font-size.$description: Style of a sub-section or card heading.

line-height.$description: Line height of the heading-3 style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the heading-3 style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the body style.

font-size.$description: Default style for paragraphs and most interface text.

line-height.$description: Line height of the body style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the body style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the body-sm style.

font-size.$description: Smaller body style, for secondary text and dense areas.

line-height.$description: Line height of the body-sm style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the body-sm style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the label style.

font-size.$description: Style of form labels and button text.

line-height.$description: Line height of the label style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the label style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the caption style.

font-size.$description: Smallest style, for captions, helper text and metadata.

line-height.$description: Line height of the caption style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the caption style.

font-family.$description: Font family of the data style.

font-size.$description: Monospace style, for numbers, codes and technical values.

line-height.$description: Line height of the data style.

font-weight.$description: Font weight of the data style.

enter.$description: Duration of an element that appears, such as a menu or dialog opening. Use motion.duration.exit when it leaves.

exit.$description: Duration of an element that leaves. It is shorter than the enter duration, so the screen feels fast.

emphasis.$description: Duration of a larger movement that needs attention, such as a page-level change.

enter.$description: Easing curve for an element that appears. Use motion.easing.exit when it leaves.

exit.$description: Easing curve for an element that leaves. It speeds up as it goes.

disabled.$description: Opacity for the text and icon colours of a disabled control. The app theme applies it to those colours, not to the whole control.

component.$description: Layer 3. Component slots. Reference semantic tokens only; never a primitive.
